outcome_leads_unverified.note: Mission Local (2026-11-20) reports the Folsom project 'has been pushed back several years' and that PUC officials said construction began in 2023 and should be completed by 2030, against the 2028 completion in the SFPUC June 2025 factsheet. SFPUC contracting list (2026-10-28) shows WW-719B Alameda Tunnel ($180M) and WW-719CR2 Harrison/Treat box sewers with bid dates TBD. No official SFPUC document stating 2030 has been fetched, so the schedule slip is a news-tier lead, not a verdict.

SFPUC release of 2026-10-23 says design is complete for the Lower Alemany project, which suggests construction had not started by the late Summer 2026 target. No source confirming a construction start or notice to proceed was found. Unresolved.
